art_direction_concept: ドライヘッドスパ・ヘッドスパスクール・ヒーリングサロンの相談窓口。を、予約前の不安をほどくの入口として見せる。
visual_mood: soft, tactile care with room to breathe before choosing

color_logic.reason: PERSON is the first evidence-bearing authority.

typography_logic: Large meaning-unit headlines, compact labels, readable Japanese body text.
composition_logic: A soft arrival opening, tactile care surface and generous booking pause; the page slows before asking for action.
photography_logic: Role-driven photography is the primary visual authority; vector scenes are support only.

replacement_targets: 実店舗・実現場・実商品・実人物写真
layout_constraints: 同一役割の実写真を同じ比率へ差し替え可能
photo_replacement_readiness.proof_role: visual_context_only; not evidence of a real result or location

icon_logic: No generic icon wall; use line markers tied to the process sequence.
texture_logic: Subtle ruled-paper and calibration marks, never a decorative grain overlay.
motion_logic: settle_into_care; one restrained reveal per section; no infinite or blocking animation.
craft_catch: A breath mark carries the customer from a vague need for care to a chosen kind of time.

art_direction_dimensions.crop_logic: no client image dependency; abstract geometry carries the role

roles.visual_subject: 静かな施術空間と施術の気配
roles.business_purpose: 安心感と体験の温度を最初に伝える
roles.replacement_target: 実店舗と実施術シーン

roles.visual_subject: 頭部への手技と施術者の手元
roles.business_purpose: 技術感と身体感覚を伝える

roles.visual_subject: タオル・照明・ベッド周りの静かなディテール
roles.business_purpose: リラックスの感覚を補強する

roles.visual_subject: 相談・迎え入れの人間的な距離感
roles.business_purpose: 初回来店の不安を下げる
